 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 15-04-2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Ramgarh (Nuaon) P.S. Case No. 436 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 325, 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is further submitted that the investigation in the case is still pending.
3. The learned APP for the State submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the petitioner carries punishment of 7 years and less, the said Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.24406 of 2024(2) dt.15-04-2024 submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

4. In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 Sadaqat Bilal Khan @ Sadaqat Belal vs The State Of Bihar on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140007010/
1 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar).
5.
